wiki.title: Linda Trujillo
wiki.extract: Linda M. Trujillo (born May 20, 1959) is an American politician who has represented the 24th district in the New Mexico Senate since 2025. She previously served in the New Mexico House of Representatives, representing the 48th district from 2017 to 2020. On July 9, 2020, she resigned from the New Mexico House of Representatives due to financial issues.
